name: anamnesis
description: Persistent encrypted memory for OpenAI Codex CLI. Three lifecycle hooks (SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit / Stop) capture every session deterministically. Encrypted at rest with per-user HKDF-derived keys, no master key (not yet end-to-end — anamnesis.smtry.ai/security says exactly who can decrypt what). Browse, search, and delete at anamnesis.smtry.ai/memory.
